Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the draft Order Form and BluePeak's PO. High-level summary and proposed language below. Attached: redlines-summary.xlsx with inline edits.

Summary / proposed approach:
- Invoice entity mapping: we can print invoices to a customer-specified entity. Proposed clause to add to Order Form: "Invoices. Customer may designate an invoicing entity in the Order Form. Redwood will issue invoices to the entity specified in the Order Form. Customer shall provide any documentary evidence reasonably requested by Redwood (for US customers, a W-9)."
- Net terms exception: commercial exceptions to payment terms should be captured in the Order Form only and do not amend the MSA. Proposed clause: "Payment Terms. Unless otherwise set forth in an Order Form, payments are due Net30. Customer and Redwood may negotiate a different payment term for a particular Order Form; any deviation from Net30 must be expressly set forth in the Order Form and approved in writing by Redwood's Finance team. Such approval shall not require amendment of the MSA."
- VAT/withholding: avoid wording that assigns open-ended liability. Proposed clause: "Taxes and Withholding. Customer is responsible for taxes imposed on Customer (including withholding taxes) except for Redwood's income taxes. If withholding is required by applicable law, Customer shall provide Redwood with appropriate documentation of the withholding and the party responsible for remitting such tax. If Customer requests Redwood to gross-up amounts to cover withholding, Customer shall notify Redwood in writing and obtain Redwood's prior written consent."

Ask: Ben / Karthik — if we want to approve Net45 for BluePeak, I need explicit sign-off from Finance (Mina) and a commercial ack that no pricing changes are required. Ben, if this is an exception tied to a larger commit or reference sale credit please flag.

I'll prepare a tracked-change Order Form for sign-off and attach redlines-summary.xlsx. If Legal/Finance are aligned, we can return to the customer with those edits + DocuSign envelope by 6/14.
